name: olmoe_merged_air
notes: Cross-HOST replication of the published #1621 arm set on a second Apple Silicon machine (M3 MacBook Air, 8 cores, 16GB). usage.txt/eval refs are the published files (main() olmoe_merged reuse block copies them); --steps cands,uniform re-derives the candidate lists deterministically (same tier cut, seed 1972), so the zeroed expert sets are byte-identical to the published run.
